skipped.reason: Death or loss of the spouse: excluded by policy.
The spouse's birth sign, direction of origin and transit timing: need navamsa and transit-to-natal tests.

rules.text: The Sun and Rahu together in the 7th: money lost through relationships.
Saturn and Mars in Cancer in the 7th: a faithful, fortunate and attractive spouse.
Venus in a sign of Mars or Saturn, or aspected by them: a pull towards affairs outside the marriage.
rules.note: The verse says a varga (division) of Mars or Saturn; encoded with the sign only.

variants.text: A 'neuter' planet (Mercury or Saturn) in the 7th with two planets in the 11th: two marriages are indicated.
The 7th lord and Venus both in dual signs: two marriages are indicated; the text counts further ones by the planets joining them.

rules.note: The verse also allows dual navamsas; encoded with signs only.

variants.text: A strong, benefic 7th lord: a good-natured partner and good children.
A malefic 7th lord in its own house: even so, it does good to the spouse.
A benefic in the 7th is good for marriage, unless it rules the 6th, 8th or 12th.

rules.note: The 'unless it rules the 6th, 8th or 12th' qualification is stated in the text but not tested for the occupant.

rules.text: The 2nd and 7th houses under benefic influence only: the couple will be lucky and enjoy every comfort.
The 7th house, its lord and Venus all in even signs, with strong 5th and 7th lords: certainly blessed with a spouse and children.
